# How I build: an AI-orchestrated engineering system

> One person runs a full production healthcare platform (iOS, Android, web, NestJS backend, GPU
> workers) by directing AI coding agents — with a system around them: reusable skills, adversarial
> review agents, and machine gates that block a bad deploy before it ships. This repo is the method;
> the product's own source stays private. The runnable, installable version is the `agent-guardrails`
> plugin.

## Start here

- [README](./README.md): the whole system in one page — skills, review agents, gates, memory.
- [Runnable plugin: agent-guardrails](https://github.com/rustidi98/agent-guardrails): `git clone` and
  `./demo.sh` blocks a hardcoded secret + a swallowed error in ~60s, then passes the fix.

## The parts

- [agents/](./agents): adversarial review specialists — "an agent is a scar, codified." One narrow lens
  each (security, silent failures, auth, DB, money math), mandatory when code in its blast radius changes.
- [skills/](./skills): ~79 codified procedures the agent loads on demand (safe DB migration, deploy,
  build verification, LLM cost pricing, eval harness).
- [pipeline/](./pipeline): the 4-phase delivery process, a sprint template, and the real machine
  review-gate script.
- [qa/](./qa): the automated browser QA loop — navigate, click, screenshot, verify the DOM before a human sees it.
- [memory/](./memory): compounding lessons — atomic, linked, loaded every session so a bug root never recurs.

## Context

- [CLAUDE.md.example](./CLAUDE.md.example): the generalized "project constitution" the agent reads first.
- Author: Rustem Idiiatullin — building clinical-conversation AI; relocating to New Zealand / Australia.
